title: Mitred Cloth Napkins (set of 4)
summary: Everyday linen napkins with crisp mitred corners.
description: Napkins are the best way to master a perfect hem. Mitred corners lie flat and look professional, and once you've made four you'll never fear corners again. Choose your size; the hem allowance stays the same.

params.label: Finished napkin size
params.help: 35 cm cocktail · 45 cm everyday · 50+ cm dinner.

customNote: Each napkin is cut at the finished size plus 2 × 2.5 cm for a double-fold hem (1 cm + 1.5 cm). Hem allowance does not change with size.

materials.name: Linen or cotton
alternatives: An old linen tablecloth or bedsheet

steps.title: Pre-wash and press
steps.text: Wash and dry the fabric — napkins get washed constantly and linen can shrink 5% or more. Press it flat.

steps.title: Cut four squares
steps.text: Cut four squares following the layout. Pull a thread or use a quilting ruler to keep them perfectly square — crooked napkins never press flat.
tips: Check squareness by measuring both diagonals; they must be equal.

steps.title: Press the hem folds
steps.text: On every edge, press 1 cm to the wrong side, then another 1.5 cm. Then unfold the second fold — you'll use the creases as guides for the mitre.
warnings: Keep fingertips clear of the iron when pressing narrow folds.

steps.title: Fold the mitred corners
steps.text: At each corner, fold the tip diagonally towards the centre so the fold passes exactly through the point where the inner creases cross. Press, trim the tip 7 mm beyond the fold, then refold both hems — the edges meet in a neat 45° line.
steps.beginner: Take it slowly on the first corner. The diagonal fold should line up with the creases on both sides; if it doesn't, unfold and adjust before you trim.

steps.title: Stitch the hems
steps.text: Stitch close to the inner fold all the way round each napkin, from the wrong side, pivoting at each corner with the needle down.

steps.title: Close the mitres (optional)
steps.text: For the crispest corners, slip-stitch the diagonal mitre seams closed by hand so they never open in the wash.

steps.title: Final press
steps.text: Press all four napkins with steam. Fold them the same way and stack.

review.note: Sample pattern; dimensions are internally consistent but not yet test-sewn.
